name: Hudson County, NJ
findings: Hudson County has 1,981 nonprofit organizations. 822 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 686 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hudson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 44 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 17 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: 17 hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 44 would.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hudson County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 563 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 195 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 195 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
